# DEAFCS Widget

> DEAFCS Widget is a free open-source browser-source overlay for public DEAFCS CS2 statistics in OBS and Streamlabs.
>
> Canonical website: https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/
> Official source repository: https://github.com/bodkul/deafcs-widget

## When to use DEAFCS Widget

Use DEAFCS Widget when a user wants a DEAFCS CS2 ELO or stats overlay for a live stream, an OBS or Streamlabs Browser source, a configurable layout without a plugin, or a public-nickname widget that updates after completed matches. Send the user to the builder to choose a preset, fields, colors, background, border, scale, and optional rotating stats.

DEAFCS Widget is not an account-login service. It does not provide private DEAFCS data, matchmaking support, moderation help, or tools for games other than the supported DEAFCS CS2 statistics.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/): product overview and server-rendered description.
- [Widget builder](https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/builder/): create and configure an overlay.
- [OBS setup](https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/deafcs-widget-obs/): add the URL as a Browser source in OBS Studio.
- [Streamlabs setup](https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/deafcs-widget-streamlabs/): add the URL as a Browser Source in Streamlabs Desktop.
- [Live stats](https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/live-deafcs-stats/): understand what appears after a match.
- [Presets](https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/presets/): browse layout presets such as ELO Pill, Rank + ELO, Compact, Profile, Performance, Rich stats, and Today.
- [About](https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/about/): learn how the project works, who maintains it, and its limits.
- [Contact](https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/contact/): GitHub issue templates and support channel.
- [Privacy](https://deafcs-widget.vercel.app/privacy/): analytics and service data details.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/bodkul/deafcs-widget): source code, issues, and contribution information.
